scope: Contextual equality of stored Guid and sixteen GUID-structure Binary bytes. Strict keys and storage stay separate; native Access remains unqualified.

checks.command: cargo test -p tablecraft-query --test guid_byte_predicates --test guid_conversion --test effective_comparisons --test numeric_keys --test union_types --locked

limitations: No native Access comparison/byte-order or error-precedence qualification.
General Binary/Binary, GUID ordering and implicit Text parsing remain refused.
Strict keys, stored values, source/parameter types and index hints are unchanged.
This does not complete P0 value semantics.
counting_note: Four new expression tests, five new query tests and one new CLI test. Three nonoverlapping selected test targets/groups total 75 tests; repeated runs are not additional tests.
